cli.help:
OpenStreamMS — Game Streaming Service

Usage:
  OpenStreamMS.exe --run               Run the service and REST API
  OpenStreamMS.exe --install           Install the Windows service
  OpenStreamMS.exe --uninstall         Stop and remove the service
  OpenStreamMS.exe --remove-deps       Uninstall ViGEmBus and HidHide
  OpenStreamMS.exe --purge-data        Delete data outside the program folder
  OpenStreamMS.exe --tray              Show the system tray icon
  OpenStreamMS.exe --open              Open the control panel in a window
  OpenStreamMS.exe --diagnostics [file.zip] [--days N]  Create a diagnostic archive
  OpenStreamMS.exe --seat-agent <pipe> [--output DISPLAY] [--no-audio]
  OpenStreamMS.exe --seat-host <pipe>  Run the local seat host
  OpenStreamMS.exe --help              Show this help

Web:
  http://localhost:<ApiPort>/          Control panel (login required)
  http://localhost:<ApiPort>/scalar/v1 Interactive API documentation

Configuration (service.config.json):
  SunshineExePath — path to sunshine.exe
  RdpBackground   — hide the RDP window
  ApiPort         — web/API server port (default: 5000)
  AdminUsername   — control panel user
  LogLevel        — Error, Warning, Info or Off
